scope: PERS-02 search command production, resolution and result events

comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0110 [confirmed]: automatic code-23 producer closes target-building, in-range city and politics>=45 available-officer lists before creating the shared search command.
RE-SAN9PK-0110 [confirmed]: search command execution records type 23, deterministic random payload and max-axis travel distance, then marks the explorer busy through the shared participant path.
RE-SAN9PK-0110 [confirmed]: search result gate combines person/item thresholds, counselor judgment and current target inventories; it returns result code 1 or no-result code 3.

RE-SAN9PK-0110 [confirmed boundary]: search person event selects from the target hidden-person list; success changes identity to 3, failure reveals the person as identity 5 at the target building, and both paths try politics growth. Recruitment probability remains PERS-03.

evidence_summary: Interactive and automatic code-23 producers converge on the shared search command; daily resolution creates search result tasks whose event objects cover person, item, funds and no-result outcomes, with automatic mode limited to event types 63, 65 and 66.
